This article is about the 25w14craftmine grid of blocks.   For the current grid of blocks, see Debug mode/Grid.   For the upcoming grid, see Debug mode/Grid/upcoming.



This article documents an April Fools' Day joke. 
This feature was exclusively part of a joke version and is not currently planned for addition to regular Minecraft.

This page lists all the rows in the debug mode block grid in 25w14craftmine.
There are 167 lines with up to 168 block states. The last line has 114 block states. Therefore, there are 28,002 block states in total.
The first block is located at coordinates (1, 70, 1) and each block is 2 blocks away from its adjacent blocks, thus the block in row r, column c is at coordinates (2r-1, 70, 2c-1).

Access debug mode
In this version, it's not possible to create a world directly in debug mode. To access a world in debug mode, you need to use an external editor to modify the level.dat file. Defining the generator type of a dimension of a 25w14craftmine world for debug.

: A world directory.
 level.dat: Stores global information about the level.
[NBT Compound / JSON Object] The root tag.
[NBT Compound / JSON Object] Data: This tag contains all the level data.
[Int] DataVersion: 4323.
[NBT Compound / JSON Object] WorldGenSettings: The generation settings for each dimension.
[NBT Compound / JSON Object] dimensions: Contains all the dimensions.
[NBT Compound / JSON Object] Dimension ID: The root for generator settings.
[NBT Compound / JSON Object] generator: Generation settings used for that dimension.
[String] type: The generator type as resource location. One of hub, noise, flat, or debug.

When loading the world, some blocks may not render; however, simply the player interacting with them will render them.
